title: RPP-4m MATERIAL procedural-property schema peer audit
mode: Pinned source crosswalk and implementation-readiness review

sources.kind: Peer implementation schema, not normative DXF semantics

findings: Autodesk lists procedural MATERIAL group codes 300, 291, 271, 469, 301, 292, 62, 420, and 430, but the table does not define complete per-property cardinality or the association rules for optional color components.

Pinned LibreDWG in_dxf.c states that its procedural-texture variants are not written by its DXF writer and remain unhandled by its generic MATERIAL import path; its handler returns unknown pairs to the generic object parser. This corroborates a peer support gap but does not define the missing semantics.
LibreDWG's internal MATERIAL schema lists genprocname, genproctype, typed values, and a CMC color value, but that internal schema alone cannot establish the DXF wire sequence.
Autodesk's DXF reference maps self-illumination to group 90 while LibreDWG's DWG schema/reader uses group 149; the conflict remains unresolved and both routes stay untyped locally.

disposition.typedImplementation: NOT_IMPLEMENTED: insufficient authoritative or producer-backed name/type/value sequence evidence
disposition.localAction: Preserve the full ordered raw MATERIAL carrier; do not infer typed procedure fields from peer internal structures.
nextEvidenceNeeded: A versioned product-authored MATERIAL DXF witness that shows a complete procedural property sequence, including scalar and CMC cases.
An authoritative source resolving whether DXF self-illumination is group 90 or group 149 for the targeted version.
